title: More models, clearer names
summary:
The API gained more ways to talk to models, while model discovery and request behavior became more consistent.

Kimi K2 Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro Preview joined the text API with reasoning and tool support; Gemini also accepts image, audio, and video input. Fast options changed too: `openai-fast` moved to GPT-5 Nano, and `mistral-fast` added Llama 3.1 8B with tools. Gemini is listed as `gemini-large`, while its earlier IDs still work as aliases.

Chat completions gained OpenAI-compatible audio fields. Requests can carry base64 audio in wav, mp3, flac, opus, or pcm16 format, and ask for audio output with a chosen voice and format.

Gateway model listings gained aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capability metadata. The image picker was updated to read the new model objects and show descriptions, while a pricing-page button added a way to vote on future models.

Enter’s text, image, and chat routes adopted one authentication and Pollen-balance rule, with successful uncached requests billed by usage. Image responses now identify the model used for Turbo and Flux; invalid model names and image parameters return HTTP 400, and text-service errors have a structured response.
